input.escena: from the standing traveler's view, a large suitcase stands upright on a bathroom scale in the hallway, the scale display lit but with no readable number; next to it a sweater and a pair of sneakers that just came out of the suitcase. The suitcase top sits in the upper half of the frame. It reads as a last-minute decision before going to the airport

input.extra: COMPOSITION, MEASURED: the suitcase stands farther down the hallway and is smaller in frame: from the top of its handle to the scale it spans from 16% to 48% of the frame height, centred between 40% and 60% of the width. The sweater and sneakers lie beside the scale inside that band. The lower half is calm wooden floor and the out-of-focus sleeve, mid-dark. SKY BRANDLIFT CONSISTENCY (Daniela Ferreira, SKY Blog visual system, sheet 15): believable traveler POV at eye height; luminous natural light with open shadows and whites that keep detail; natural colour where ochres, blues and skin keep their true tones, moderate contrast, no filter, no orange-teal grade, no HDR; real optical depth: the near element very out of focus with soft optical bokeh, the subject sharp; a spontaneous everyday moment, no pose. LENS: 50 mm equivalent, close lived detail of hands and objects, intimate without isolating them from the place.
